usage: 叉燒包 refers to a steamed bun filled with barbecued pork.
It functions as a noun and can be used as the subject or object in a sentence.
It can be counted with measure words, for example 三個叉燒包 means 'three BBQ pork buns'.
It is commonly used when talking about dim sum or Cantonese food.
You can use it in ordering situations, such as 有冇叉燒包？meaning 'Do you have char siu buns?'
